**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (paragraphs p0073–p0074) already contains a Vendor-side insurance covenant that meets or exceeds our preferred position:

| Playbook (preferred) | Section 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Matches exactly |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ Matches |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M where processing Customer Data | ✅ **Exceeds** — required unconditionally, not conditioned on Customer Data processing |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ Matches, plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ In 18.2 |

Additional favorable terms beyond our model language:
- Coverage period runs through the term **and one year afterward**, mirroring our model clause.
- Policies must be from reputable insurers and primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary.
- Advance notice of cancellation or material reduction (qualified by insurer availability — a customary and acceptable limitation).
- Express statement that insurance does **not** limit Vendor's liabilities, preserving our recovery beyond policy limits.

Direction check: every obligation in Section 18 binds Silverline Systems Ltd. as Vendor and runs in our favor as Customer, so there is nothing to push back on. No fallback position needs to be raised.
